prefix_key.description: The prefix key combination. e.g., 'C-b' or 'C-a'.

escape_time.description: Time in milliseconds for which tmux waits after an escape is input to determine if it is part of a function or meta key sequences.

history_limit.description: The maximum number of lines held in window history.

status_enabled.description: Show or hide the status line. Values: 'on', 'off', or a number for height.

status_style.description: The style for the entire status line. e.g., 'bg=black,fg=white'.

status_left_text.description: The format string for the left side of the status line. e.g., '#S' for session name.

status_left_style.description: The style for the left part of the status line.

status_right_text.description: The format string or command output for the right side of the status line.

status_right_style.description: The style for the right part of the status line.

mouse_enabled.description: If 'on', tmux captures the mouse and allows mouse events to be bound.

base_index.description: The base index for window and pane numbering. Usually 0 or 1.

reattach_on_detach.description: If true, bind 'r' to reattach to the current session if detached.
